system.description:
Fate smiles upon Miko and they may use this favor to manipulate the fate of the world. Gain a number of Unmei points equal to 1 + Arcane Might. These may be spent to grant one automatic success to a roll made by the Miko. You must declare how many Unmei you plan to spend before the roll is made. You cannot spend more than two Unmei on a single roll. Unmei dice may not be used on any roll that Luck cannot be used on.

You may alternatively spend a single Unmei dice as an action on a target you are touching to treat any non-Lethal wound, or two to treat a Lethal injury. You may also spend dice in a similar fashion to immediately heal the injury by spending an amount of dice equal to the Injury’s level. You may also cleanse sicknesses or ailments with a cost determined by the severity of the illness and how far it has progressed within the subject.

At Arcane Might III or greater you may heal or treat minor injuries or ailments at no cost. At Arcane Might V you may treat all wounds (though not heal), except Lethal wounds at no cost and treat Lethal wounds by spending only a single dice.

Unmei is restored upon completing a rest, and once per rest you may spend ten Favor to restore all your Unmei dice.
